rule.title: Berkeley security deposit interest
rule.requirement: In Berkeley units fully or partly covered by the Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit every year, plus a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before year end.
rule.requirement_es: En las unidades de Berkeley cubiertas total o parcialmente por la Ordenanza de Renta, los propietarios deben pagar a los inquilinos intereses sobre su depósito de seguridad cada año, más una cantidad prorrateada si el inquilino se muda antes de fin de año.
rule.coverage_text: Tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.

applies_if.value_text: Unit fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance

rule.quote: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
